title: 503 & 523 Urban Loop Road

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located in downtown San Antonio. It fronts Urban Loop Road on the east and IH-35 (elevated) to the west.

rows.label: Size
rows.text: 1.87 +/- Acres which includes a 16,853 +/- SF warehouse building

rows.label: Utilities
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility, and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2024 and 2029.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not appear to indicate any floodplain on the site.

rows.label: Potential Use
rows.text: This property would suit a variety of commercial or residential uses that are typical in downtown.

comments: This property is a redevelopment site.
The site is within one block of the UTSA Downtown Campus.
HEB Headquarters is located one and a half blocks to the east of the site.

qa_notes: STALE SPEC DEMOGRAPHICS: the spec-page table is headed '2025 ESRI Estimates' but its source line says 'ESRI forecasts for 2024 and 2029', and none of its numbers match the October 20, 2025 Demographic Overview (spec 16,936 / 141,081 / 345,977 population and $70,338 / $67,021 / $69,523 income vs overview 17,479 / 140,481 / 343,061 and $69,517 / $70,604 / $74,126). Transcribed as printed; the spec table should be refreshed from the overview.

HEB DISTANCE MISMATCH: PDF comment says 'one and a half blocks to the east'; Prismic highlight says 'one and a half miles to the east'. On the p6 aerial the H-E-B Headquarters label sits roughly 0.3-0.4 mile southeast of the site, so neither wording is clearly right.

VARIANT: classified 'existing' (Existing Property) because the package is 'FOR SALE OR LEASE', includes a 16,853 +/- SF warehouse, exterior cover photo, interior photos and a floor plan. However the first comment calls it 'a redevelopment site' and Prismic files it under 'Land — SA Metro & Surrounding'. Confirm with broker which template to use.
TRANSACTION: 'For Sale or Lease' (cover and Investment row); Prismic transaction_type 'Sale or Lease' (match).
BUILDING SIZE: spec 16,853 +/- SF; the floor plan's overall dimensions (159'-2" x 107'-6") give about 17,110 SF gross. Small difference, likely a measurement-basis difference; flagging only.
SIZE: 1.87 +/- Acres; aerial headers '1.87 AC +/-'; Prismic 1.87 acres (match). No acreage line on the cover.
ZONING: PDF 'Downtown District, San Antonio'; Prismic 'Downtown District, City of San Antonio' (same district, different wording).
PRICE: 'Contact Broker (For Sale or Lease)'; Prismic 'Contact Broker' (match).
TITLE: '503 & 523 Urban Loop Road' matches Prismic title.
Prismic highlight 1 reads 'The property is a redevelopment site.'; PDF reads 'This property is a redevelopment site.'
Demographic Overview: 3.0-mile Owner-Occupied 25,291 + Renter-Occupied 30,667 = 55,958, but 2025 Households (3.0 mi) is 55,968 (10 off). Other columns sum exactly. Transcribed as printed.
Image typo on p7 aerial: road label reads 'W. Cesar E. Chaveez Blvd.' (should be Chavez) - baked into the image.
Unlike most packages, there is no Traffic Count, Topography or Area Development row.
